expected_effects: Robot arm moves to a pre-grasp pose near the blue cube.
Gripper closes around the blue cube.
Object is lifted slightly to verify hold.
Confirmation that the object is securely held.
edges.trigger: If grasp confidence is low, re-grasp or adjust.

expected_effects: Robot moves the blue cube to a position above the transparent box.
Gripper opens to release the cube.
preconditions: Cube is aligned with box opening.
Path to release point is clear.

expected_effects: Visual confirmation that the blue cube is inside the transparent box.

goal_interpretation: Identify the blue cube and the transparent box in the scene, grasp the blue cube, transport it to the interior of the transparent box, and release it so that it rests inside the container.

nodes.description: Initial scene state with objects on the table.
observable_conditions: Blue cube is visible on the table surface.
Transparent box is visible on the table surface.
unknown_conditions: Exact pose and orientation of the blue cube.
Exact pose and opening orientation of the transparent box.

nodes.description: Robot end-effector positioned near the blue cube for grasping.
observable_conditions: End-effector is close to the blue cube.
unknown_conditions: Collision-free path existence to the grasp pose.
Occlusion status from the current camera view.

nodes.description: Robot has successfully grasped the blue cube.
observable_conditions: Blue cube is attached to the gripper.

nodes.description: Blue cube is positioned directly above the opening of the transparent box.
observable_conditions: Blue cube is aligned with the box interior.
unknown_conditions: Clearance between cube and box walls.

nodes.description: Blue cube is released and resting inside the transparent box.
observable_conditions: Blue cube is no longer held by the robot.
Blue cube is visually contained within the transparent box boundaries.
unknown_conditions: Final resting orientation of the cube.
Whether the cube is stable or might tip over.

objects.description: A blue cubic object intended for manipulation.
A transparent container acting as the target destination.

physical_checks: Verify that the blue cube fits through the opening of the transparent box.
Check for potential collisions between the robot arm and the box during placement.
Ensure the transparent box is stable and will not tip over when the cube is dropped.
Confirm that the gripper can securely grasp the blue cube given its material properties.
